units.rawText: You've been working hard, Professor. Dushevnaya has brought you cake.

spans.text: You've been working hard, Professor. Dushevnaya has brought you cake.

units.rawText: Thank you, Dushevnaya... Is there something wrong? You look rather upset.
units.displayText: Thank you, Dushevnaya... Is there something wrong? You look rather upset.

spans.text: Thank you, Dushevnaya... Is there something wrong? You look rather upset.

units.rawText: It's nothing... Dushevnaya really wants to help Professor... but Dushevnaya can't remember anything. My memories before entering the Cloud were inconsistent, and memories after are blurry. Dushevnaya isn't even sure how she came to the Oasis... I'm sorry, Professor...

units.rawText: N-No need to apologize. Although I don't know your past, I've remembered how I found you, Dushevnaya.
units.displayText: N-No need to apologize. Although I don't know your past, I've remembered how I found you, Dushevnaya.

units.rawText: You've already recovered that memory? That's great!

spans.text: You've already recovered that memory? That's great!

units.rawText: Mm-hmm. I was heading out for fieldwork when I noticed a Doll's signal near the Oasis. That's how I found you, fainted. Now that I think about it, you've often hummed that same song since I first met you.

units.rawText: Was Dushevnaya also humming that song back then? Dushevnaya is struggling to remember the second half of the song... and the granny who often appears in my dreams, along with that elder sister with blue hair...

units.rawText: Don't worry, just like how I'm recovering my memories, one day it will be Dushevnaya's turn to remember everything... Maybe the people in your dream will help you!
